faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I specialize in Data Analysis, Machine Learning (Regression, Classification, Clustering), and building AI-powered tools including Prompt Engineering gateways and Agentic AI systems.

faqData.q: Are you available for data science opportunities?
faqData.a: Yes! I'm actively looking for Data Scientist, Data Analyst, and ML Developer roles. I'm also open to freelance collaborations on data-driven projects.

faqData.q: What is your typical tech stack?
faqData.a: For ML projects, I use Python with scikit-learn, XGBoost, and pandas. For data visualization, I rely on Tableau, Power BI, and matplotlib. For deployment, I use Streamlit, FastAPI, and Vercel.

faqData.q: What analytics and visualization tools do you use?
faqData.a: I use Tableau, Power BI, Excel, and Python libraries (pandas, matplotlib, seaborn) to parse, analyze, and visualize complex data structures into actionable insights.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: The most efficient way is to use the contact form above or reach out directly via email at gokulr.1105@gmail.com. I'm usually able to respond within 24 hours to discuss how my data science skills can add value to your initiatives.
